source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Fused UDF and Source Cooperative hosting contract.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: The Overture Fused UDF loads Overture GeoParquet files hosted by Source Cooperative and accepts a bbox with optional release, dataset and column selection. Building is a supported Overture type.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Public repository contents and visible release inventory.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: The Source Cooperative Fused Overture product is public and geo-partitioned. The visible directory inventory includes releases through 2026-05-20-0, followed by docs and README.md; it does not visibly list 2026-07-22-0 in the indexed snapshot.

The mirror README states that releases are divided by theme and type into GeoParquet files and include Parquet metadata (_metadata) and sample (_sample) files. Building footprints use theme=buildings/type=building, sometimes subdivided into parts.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official current distribution path and building type contract.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Official Overture data is hosted on Amazon S3 and Azure as GeoParquet, partitioned by theme and type. Buildings includes building and building_part. Community mirrors can offer different access patterns but are not the source of record.
